```{ojs}
  const sspLabels  = { ssp126:"SSP1-2.6", ssp245:"SSP2-4.5", ssp370:"SSP3-7.0", ssp585:"SSP5-8.5" };

  // Country → always admin1. Region → follow toggle (default admin0).
  const useAdmin1Map = isCountry ? true : (mapLevel === "admin1");

  // Colour scale: 5 bins + "not within century" grey.
  const periodColours = {
    "2021-2040": "#e31a1c",
    "2041-2060": "#fd8d3c",
    "2061-2080": "#fecc5c",
    "2081-2100": "#ffffb2",
    null:        "#cccccc",
  };
  const periodLabels = {
    "2021-2040": "2021–2040 (earliest)",
    "2041-2060": "2041–2060",
    "2061-2080": "2061–2080",
    "2081-2100": "2081–2100 (latest)",
    null:        "Threshold not reached by 2100",
  };

  // Loading state — data not yet arrived.
  if (!cr097_data || !cr097_data.length) return htl.html`<p style="color:#888;font-style:italic;padding:12px 0;">
    ⏳ Fetching CMIP6 future-projection parquets (DuckDB-WASM, ~20 MB across 4 files — may take 15–30 s)…
  </p>`;

  // Helper: first period >= threshold.
  const firstCrossing = (rows, t) => {
    const sorted = [...rows].sort((a,b) => a.period.localeCompare(b.period));
    return sorted.find(d => Number(d.pmean) >= t)?.period ?? null;
  };

  // Admin1 rows always fetched. For admin0/region view: aggregate to iso3 per (scenario,period).
  // Aggregation key reflects map level — admin1_name for admin1 view, iso3 for admin0.
  const aggData = useAdmin1Map
    ? cr097_data.map(d => ({ join_key: d.admin1_name, scenario: d.scenario, period: d.period, pmean: Number(d.pmean) }))
    : [...d3.group(cr097_data, d => `${d.iso3}|${d.scenario}|${d.period}`)].map(([k, rs]) => {
        const [jk, scenario, period] = k.split("|");
        return { join_key: jk, scenario, period, pmean: d3.mean(rs, d => Number(d.pmean)) };
      });

  const byScenario = d3.group(aggData, d => d.scenario);

  // join_key — admin1_name or iso3
  const joinKey = d => d.join_key;

  // Select topojson layer and feature key based on map level.
  const useAdmin1 = useAdmin1Map;
  const allFeatures = useAdmin1
    ? topojson.feature(cr097_topo,    cr097_topo.objects["atlas_gaul24_a1_africa"]).features
    : topojson.feature(cr097_topo_a0, cr097_topo_a0.objects["atlas_gaul24_a0_africa"]).features;
  const featureProp = useAdmin1Map ? "admin1_name" : "iso3";

  // Filter features to current scope.
  const countryFeatures = allFeatures.filter(f => iso3List.includes(f.properties.iso3));
  const selAdmin1 = useAdmin1 ? (cr097_admin1 ?? []) : [];
  const features = selAdmin1.length > 0
    ? countryFeatures.filter(f => selAdmin1.includes(f.properties[featureProp]))
    : countryFeatures;

  // Table mode: render crossing table instead of maps.
  if (showTable) {
    const keys = [...new Set(aggData.map(d => d.join_key))].sort();
    const keyLabel = useAdmin1Map ? "Admin1" : "Country";
    const th = `padding:4px 8px;text-align:left;border-bottom:2px solid #999;font-size:0.8em;background:#eee;white-space:nowrap;`;
    const td = `padding:3px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee;font-size:0.8em;white-space:nowrap;`;
    return htl.html`<div style="overflow-x:auto;margin-top:6px;">
      <p style="font-size:0.83em;color:#777;margin:2px 0 4px;">
        ${scope} · ${variable} · ${season} · vs 1995–2014 baseline · first 20-yr period crossing threshold
      </p>
      <table style="border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;">
        <thead><tr>
          <th style="${th}">${keyLabel}</th>
          ${ssps.flatMap(s => thresholds.map(t =>
            htl.html`<th style="${th}">${sspLabels[s]} ≥+${t}°C</th>`
          ))}
        </tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          ${keys
            .filter(k => selAdmin1.length === 0 || selAdmin1.includes(k))
            .map(k => htl.html`<tr>
            <td style="${td}">${k}</td>
            ${ssps.flatMap(s => {
              const sRows = d3.group(byScenario.get(s) ?? [], joinKey);
              return thresholds.map(t => {
                const cross = firstCrossing(sRows.get(k) ?? [], t);
                return htl.html`<td style="${td};color:${periodColours[cross ?? null]};">
                  ${periodLabels[cross ?? null]}
                </td>`;
              });
            })}
          </tr>`)}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>`;
  }

  if (!features.length) return htl.html`<p style="color:#c00">
    No map features for <strong>${scope}</strong> (${aggData.length} data rows, ${countryFeatures.length} topojson features before filter).
    Check that iso3List = [${iso3List.join(",")}] matches topojson iso3 property.
  </p>`;

  // Facet dimensions: cols = SSPs, rows = thresholds.
  const nCols  = Math.max(ssps.length, 1);
  const nRows  = Math.max(thresholds.length, 1);
  const labelW = 52;  // left label column
  const facetW = Math.max(160, Math.floor((width - labelW - nCols * 2) / nCols));
  const facetH = Math.round(facetW * 0.85);
  const proj0  = d3.geoMercator().fitSize([facetW - 12, facetH - 24],
    { type: "FeatureCollection", features });
  const path0  = d3.geoPath().projection(proj0);

  // SSP column headers
  const colHeaders = htl.html`<div style="display:flex;gap:2px;margin-left:${labelW}px;margin-bottom:2px;">
    ${ssps.map(s => htl.html`<div style="width:${facetW}px;text-align:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:bold;color:#333;">${sspLabels[s]}</div>`)}
  </div>`;

  // Grid rows
  const gridRows = thresholds.map(t => {
    const cells = ssps.map(s => {
      const sRows   = byScenario.get(s) ?? [];
      const byKey   = d3.group(sRows, joinKey);
      const crossing = new Map([...byKey].map(([k, rs]) => [k, firstCrossing(rs, t)]));

      const svg = d3.create("svg")
        .attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${facetW} ${facetH}`)
        .attr("width", facetW).attr("height", facetH)
        .style("border", "1px solid #eee");
      const g = svg.append("g").attr("transform", "translate(6, 4)");

      // Pass 1: all country admin1 boundaries as grey outlines (always visible).
      for (const f of countryFeatures) {
        g.append("path").attr("d", path0(f))
          .attr("fill", selAdmin1.length > 0 ? "#f5f5f5" : "none")
          .attr("stroke", "#888").attr("stroke-width", 0.5);
      }
      // Pass 2: selected (or all when no selection) filled with threshold colour — no stroke here.
      for (const f of features) {
        const cross = crossing.get(f.properties[featureProp]) ?? null;
        g.append("path").attr("d", path0(f))
          .attr("fill", periodColours[cross]).attr("stroke", "none")
          .append("title")
          .text(`${f.properties[featureProp]}: ${periodLabels[cross ?? null]}`);
      }
      // Pass 3: all boundary lines on top of everything — always visible.
      for (const f of countryFeatures) {
        g.append("path").attr("d", path0(f))
          .attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", "#888").attr("stroke-width", 0.5);
      }
      return svg.node();
    });

    return htl.html`<div style="display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:2px;">
      <div style="width:${labelW}px;font-size:10px;font-weight:bold;color:#c00;text-align:right;padding-right:6px;">≥+${t}°C</div>
      ${cells}
    </div>`;
  });

  // Shared legend
  const legSvg = d3.create("svg").attr("width", width).attr("height", 24);
  let lx = labelW;
  for (const [p, label] of Object.entries(periodLabels)) {
    legSvg.append("rect").attr("x", lx).attr("y", 5).attr("width", 11).attr("height", 11)
      .attr("fill", periodColours[p]).attr("stroke", "#aaa").attr("stroke-width", 0.5);
    legSvg.append("text").attr("x", lx+14).attr("y", 14).attr("font-size", 9).attr("fill", "#333")
      .text(label);
    lx += label.length * 5.2 + 26;
  }

  return htl.html`<div>
    <p style="font-size:0.83em;color:#777;margin:2px 0 4px;">
      ${scope} · ${variable} · ${season} season · vs 1995–2014 baseline
    </p>
    ${colHeaders}
    ${gridRows}
    ${legSvg.node()}
    <p style="font-size:0.78em;color:#888;font-style:italic;margin:6px 0 0;max-width:980px;line-height:1.4;">
      <strong>Reading note:</strong> First period in which the <em>ensemble-mean</em> CMIP6 anomaly
      exceeds the threshold. Individual GCMs cross thresholds 1–2 decades earlier or later than the
      mean — this map understates the inter-model spread. For SSP1-2.6, low-threshold (+1 °C)
      crossings may be transient (the ensemble mean can drop back below later in the century); the
      map shows <em>first</em>, not <em>sustained</em>, exceedance.
    </p>
  </div>`;
}
```

---

## P6 — Spatial climate change by decade (observational maps)

Choropleth grid using CHIRPS-CHIRTS-ERA5 observational data. **Rows = stats** (mean anomaly vs
baseline / linear trend / interannual variability). **Columns = decades**. Each cell shows
admin1 or admin0 polygons coloured by that stat for that decade. Trend computed client-side.
No pipeline work needed — uses existing `adm1_obs.parquet`.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## About this section

**Purpose.** Admin-level choropleth maps comparing observed climate
statistics across multiple decades — mean anomaly, variability, and
full-record trend — for a selected variable and season. Enables
spatial identification of warming / drying / wetting hotspots and
sub-national regions of changing variability. Complements the
single-country time-series views above by exposing **where** the
change is concentrated within a country or region.

**How to read it.** *Decade grid:* compare colour intensity across the
columns to track decade-by-decade change. Mean-anomaly panels are
relative to the full baseline window; admin1s with decades inside the
baseline (e.g. 1990s when baseline = 1991–2020) will show smaller
anomalies — that is expected. *Variability panels:* darker shading =
higher inter-annual standard deviation in that decade, **independent
of trend direction**. Palette is **Purples** (or Viridis in CB mode)
so darker ≠ "wetter" — this avoids the colour-meaning conflict for
PTOT and SPEI.

*Full-record trend maps* (below the decade grid): show the
statistically tested direction of the long-term trend. **Black border /
dot** marks Mann-Kendall significance (p &lt; 0.05). For regional views
with &gt;80 features, non-significant admin1s are **faded** instead of
dotted (dots become unreadable at that density). The decade-grid
"Trend (per decade)" stat — when toggled on — uses a simple OLS slope
on ≤10-year windows; it is **indicative only**. The full-record map
beneath uses **Theil-Sen + Mann-Kendall + TFPW** (trend-free
pre-whitening) — the same methodology as the main notebook's Recent
Changes section.

**Methods.** Data: CHIRPS-CHIRTS-ERA5 `adm1_obs.parquet` (sub-national
annual / seasonal aggregates) or `adm0_obs.parquet`. Trend slope:
Theil-Sen estimator (median of pairwise slopes — robust to outliers).
Significance: non-parametric Mann-Kendall test on TFPW-pre-whitened
residuals at α = 0.05 (Yue & Wang 2002). Variability:
`d3.deviation` of annual values per decade. Variability trend (in the
full-record map): Theil-Sen slope of a 5-year rolling mean-absolute-
residual series (detrended to remove mean-shift confound), normalised
by baseline σ → %/decade. PTOT variability is suppressed for admin1s
with baseline mean &lt; 10 mm/month (arid-zone artefact). SPEI is already
a standardised z-score, so its variability trend is intentionally not
displayed.

**Citations.** Funk et al. (2015); Hersbach et al. (2020); Yue & Wang
(2002); Mann (1945); Kendall (1975); Vicente-Serrano et al. (2010) for
the SPEI baseline definition. See [References](#references).
:::

```{ojs}
viewof p6_controls = {
  const SCOPE_OPTS = ["AGO","BWA","BEN","BFA","CIV","CMR","COD","ETH","GHA","GIN",
    "KEN","MDG","MLI","MOZ","MRT","MWI","NAM","NER","NGA","RWA","SDN","SEN",
    "SLE","SOM","SSD","TGO","TZA","UGA","ZAF","ZMB","ZWE",
    "R:WAF","R:EAF","R:CAF","R:SAF","R:NAF","R:AFR"];
  const SCOPE_LABELS = { AGO:"Angola", BWA:"Botswana", BEN:"Benin", BFA:"Burkina Faso",
    CIV:"Côte d'Ivoire", CMR:"Cameroon", COD:"DR Congo", ETH:"Ethiopia", GHA:"Ghana",
    GIN:"Guinea", KEN:"Kenya", MDG:"Madagascar", MLI:"Mali", MOZ:"Mozambique",
    MRT:"Mauritania", MWI:"Malawi", NAM:"Namibia", NER:"Niger", NGA:"Nigeria",
    RWA:"Rwanda", SDN:"Sudan", SEN:"Senegal", SLE:"Sierra Leone", SOM:"Somalia",
    SSD:"South Sudan", TGO:"Togo", TZA:"Tanzania", UGA:"Uganda", ZAF:"South Africa",
    ZMB:"Zambia", ZWE:"Zimbabwe",
    "R:WAF":"── West Africa","R:EAF":"── East Africa","R:CAF":"── Central Africa",
    "R:SAF":"── Southern Africa","R:NAF":"── North Africa","R:AFR":"── All Africa" };

  const _scope    = Inputs.select(SCOPE_OPTS, { label:"Country / Region", value:"KEN",
                      format: v => SCOPE_LABELS[v] ?? v });
  const _var      = Inputs.select(
                      ["TAVG","TMAX","TMIN","PTOT","SPEI-03","SPEI-12"],
                      { label:"Variable", value:"TAVG",
                        format: v => ({
                          TAVG:"TAVG — avg temp", TMAX:"TMAX — mean daily max", TMIN:"TMIN — mean daily min",
                          PTOT:"PTOT — precipitation",
                          "SPEI-03":"SPEI-03 (3-month) ★ main notebook",
                          "SPEI-12":"SPEI-12 (12-month) ★",
                        }[v] ?? v) });
  const _season   = Inputs.select(["annual","MAM","OND","JJA","DJF"],
                      { label:"Season", value:"annual" });
  const _base     = Inputs.select(["1991-2020","1995-2014"],
                      { label:"Baseline", value:"1991-2020",
                        format: v => v === "1991-2020" ? "1991–2020 (WMO)" : "1995–2014 (Atlas)" });
  const _decades  = Inputs.checkbox(["1980s","1990s","2000s","2010s","2020s"],
                      { label:"Decades (cols)", value:["1990s","2000s","2010s","2020s"] });
  const _stats    = Inputs.checkbox(
                      ["Mean","Min","Max","Mean anomaly","Trend (per decade)","Variability (σ)"],
                      { label:"Stats (rows)",
                        value:["Mean anomaly","Trend (per decade)"] });
  const _level    = Inputs.radio(["admin1","admin0"],
                      { label:"Level", value:"admin1",
                        format: v => v === "admin1" ? "Admin1" : "Admin0 (country)" });

  const _sigBdr  = Inputs.toggle({ label: "Trend: significance border", value: true });
  const _sigDot  = Inputs.toggle({ label: "Trend: significance dot", value: true });

  const form = htl.html`<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;">
    <div style="min-width:200px;flex:1 1 200px;">${_scope}</div>
    <div style="min-width:140px;flex:1 1 140px;">${_var}</div>
    <div style="min-width:140px;flex:1 1 140px;">${_season}</div>
    <div style="min-width:200px;flex:1 1 200px;">${_base}</div>
    <div style="min-width:260px;flex:1 1 260px;">${_decades}</div>
    <div style="min-width:320px;flex:1 1 320px;">${_stats}</div>
    <div style="min-width:180px;flex:1 1 180px;">${_level}</div>
    <div style="min-width:220px;flex:1 1 220px;">${_sigBdr}</div>
    <div style="min-width:200px;flex:1 1 200px;">${_sigDot}</div>
  </div>`;
  Object.defineProperty(form, "value", {
    get: () => ({
      scope: _scope.value, variable: _var.value, season: _season.value,
      baseline: _base.value, decades: _decade_arr(_decades.value),
      stats: _stats.value, level: _level.value,
      sigBorders: _sigBdr.value, sigDots: _sigDot.value,
    }),
  });
  function _decade_arr(sel) { return sel.length ? sel : ["2010s"]; }
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Scope → iso3 list (reuse CR-097 region defs).
p6_scope_info = {
  const scope = p6_controls.scope;
  const isCountry = !scope.startsWith("R:");
  const R = cr097_region_defs;
  const ALL = Object.values(R).flat();
  const iso3List = isCountry ? [scope]
    : scope === "R:AFR" ? ALL
    : (R[scope] ?? [scope]);
  return { isCountry, iso3List };
}
```

```{ojs}
// Separate DuckDB client for P6 — avoids blocking CR-097 queries.
db_p6 = DuckDBClient.of()
```

```{ojs}
// Observational annual/seasonal data for selected country/region.
p6_obs_raw = {
  const { iso3List } = p6_scope_info;
  const { variable, season, level } = p6_controls;
  const iso3In = iso3List.map(c => `'${c}'`).join(",");
  const url = level === "admin1"
    ? "https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/domain=climate/type=observational/source=chirps-chirts-era5/region=africa/processing=admin-periods/variable=adm1_obs.parquet"
    : "https://digital-atlas.s3.amazonaws.com/domain=climate/type=observational/source=chirps-chirts-era5/region=africa/processing=admin-periods/variable=adm0_obs.parquet";
  const keyCol = level === "admin1" ? "admin1_name, iso3" : "iso3";
  const rows = await db_p6.query(`
    SELECT ${keyCol}, year, value_mean
    FROM read_parquet('${url}')
    WHERE iso3 IN (${iso3In}) AND variable = '${variable}' AND period = '${season}'
      AND value_mean IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY iso3, ${level === "admin1" ? "admin1_name," : ""} year
  `);
  return Array.from(rows).map(d => ({
    ...d, year: Number(d.year), value_mean: Number(d.value_mean),
    join_key: level === "admin1" ? d.admin1_name : d.iso3,
  }));
}
```

```{ojs}
// Per-admin baseline means over selected window.
p6_base_means = {
  const [lo, hi] = p6_controls.baseline === "1991-2020" ? [1991, 2020] : [1995, 2014];
  const byKey = d3.group(p6_obs_raw.filter(d => d.year >= lo && d.year <= hi), d => d.join_key);
  const m = new Map();
  for (const [k, rows] of byKey) m.set(k, d3.mean(rows, d => d.value_mean));
  return m;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Compute stat per (join_key × decade).
p6_stats = {
  const decadeRanges = {
    "1980s": [1980, 1989], "1990s": [1990, 1999],
    "2000s": [2000, 2009], "2010s": [2010, 2019], "2020s": [2020, 2029],
  };

  // Linear trend slope (value units per year → × 10 = per decade).
  const linSlope = (pairs) => {
    const n = pairs.length;
    if (n < 4) return null;
    const xm = d3.mean(pairs, d => d.year);
    const ym = d3.mean(pairs, d => d.value_mean);
    const num = d3.sum(pairs, d => (d.year - xm) * (d.value_mean - ym));
    const den = d3.sum(pairs, d => (d.year - xm) ** 2);
    return den > 0 ? (num / den) * 10 : null;
  };

  const result = [];
  const byKey = d3.group(p6_obs_raw, d => d.join_key);

  for (const [key, allRows] of byKey) {
    const baseMean = p6_base_means.get(key) ?? null;
    for (const [dec, [lo, hi]] of Object.entries(decadeRanges)) {
      const decRows = allRows.filter(d => d.year >= lo && d.year <= hi);
      if (!decRows.length) continue;
      const vals = decRows.map(d => d.value_mean);
      const mean = d3.mean(vals);
      result.push({
        join_key: key,
        decade: dec,
        "Mean":              mean ?? null,
        "Min":               d3.min(vals) ?? null,
        "Max":               d3.max(vals) ?? null,
        "Mean anomaly":      baseMean != null && mean != null ? mean - baseMean : null,
        "Trend (per decade)": linSlope(decRows),
        "Variability (σ)":   d3.deviation(vals) ?? null,
      });
    }
  }
  return result;
}
```

```{ojs}
{
  if (!p6_obs_raw.length) return htl.html`<p style="color:#888;font-style:italic;">⏳ Loading observational data…</p>`;

  const { scope, variable, season, stats, level } = p6_controls;
  const decades = p6_controls.decades;
  const { isCountry, iso3List } = p6_scope_info;
  const isPTOT = variable === "PTOT";
  const isSPEI = variable.startsWith("SPEI");
  const isWetVar = isPTOT || isSPEI;  // positive = wetter = blue
  const rawUnit = isPTOT ? "mm" : isSPEI ? "σ" : "°C";
  const unit = { "Mean": rawUnit, "Min": rawUnit, "Max": rawUnit,
                 "Mean anomaly":       rawUnit,
                 "Trend (per decade)": isPTOT ? "mm/dec" : isSPEI ? "σ/dec" : "°C/dec",
                 "Variability (σ)":    rawUnit };

  // Features: admin1 or admin0 topojson filtered to scope.
  const allFeatures = level === "admin1"
    ? topojson.feature(cr097_topo,    cr097_topo.objects["atlas_gaul24_a1_africa"]).features
    : topojson.feature(cr097_topo_a0, cr097_topo_a0.objects["atlas_gaul24_a0_africa"]).features;
  const featProp = level === "admin1" ? "admin1_name" : "iso3";
  const features = allFeatures.filter(f => iso3List.includes(f.properties.iso3));
  if (!features.length) return htl.html`<p style="color:#c00">No features for ${scope}.</p>`;

  // Build lookup: Map<stat, Map<decade, Map<join_key, value>>>
  const byStatDecade = new Map();
  for (const stat of stats) {
    const byDec = new Map();
    for (const dec of decades) {
      const decRows = p6_stats.filter(d => d.decade === dec);
      byDec.set(dec, new Map(decRows.map(d => [d.join_key, d[stat]])));
    }
    byStatDecade.set(stat, byDec);
  }

  // Auto-scale each stat across ALL decades (symmetric for anomaly/trend).
  const SYMM_STATS = new Set(["Mean anomaly","Trend (per decade)"]);
  const SEQ_STATS  = new Set(["Mean","Min","Max","Variability (σ)"]);

  const statExtent = new Map([...stats, "Trend (per decade)"].map(stat => {
    const vals = p6_stats.map(d => d[stat]).filter(v => v != null);
    if (SYMM_STATS.has(stat)) {
      const absMax = d3.max(vals, Math.abs) || 1;
      return [stat, [-absMax, absMax]];
    }
    return [stat, [d3.min(vals) ?? 0, d3.max(vals) ?? 1]];
  }));

  // PTOT: positive anomaly = wetter = blue; temperature: warm = red. Reverse direction for precip.
  // Variability uses Purples (neutral) so it doesn't read as "wetter" for PTOT/SPEI.
  const colourFn = (stat, v, extent) => {
    if (v == null) return "#ddd";
    const [lo, hi] = extent;
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (v - lo) / (hi - lo)));
    if (SEQ_STATS.has(stat)) {
      if (stat === "Variability (σ)") {
        // Neutral palette so darker = more variable, never confused with wet/warm conventions.
        return cbMode ? d3.interpolateViridis(0.15 + 0.7 * t) : d3.interpolatePurples(0.15 + 0.7 * t);
      }
      // Sequential Mean/Min/Max: for PTOT use BuGn (blue=wet), for temp Inferno (bright=hot)
      return cbMode
        ? d3.interpolatePlasma(t)
        : isWetVar ? d3.interpolateBuGn(t) : d3.interpolateInferno(0.1 + 0.85 * t);
    }
    // Diverging direction by stat/variable:
    // temp: warm=red (1-t), wetvar: wet=blue (t)
    const dir = isWetVar ? t : 1 - t;
    return cbMode ? d3.interpolatePuOr(dir) : d3.interpolateRdBu(dir);
  };

  // Trend (per decade) is unreliable at <10 years — exclude from decade grid,
  // shown separately below as a full-record trend map.
  const gridStats = stats.filter(s => s !== "Trend (per decade)");

  const labelW = 130;
  const facetW = Math.max(180, Math.floor((width - labelW - decades.length * 4) / decades.length));
  const facetH = Math.round(facetW * 1.1);  // taller ratio to avoid southern truncation

  const proj0 = d3.geoMercator().fitSize([facetW - 8, facetH - 8], { type:"FeatureCollection", features });
  const path0 = d3.geoPath().projection(proj0);

  // Column headers
  const colH = htl.html`<div style="display:flex;gap:4px;margin-left:${labelW}px;margin-bottom:2px;">
    ${decades.map(d => htl.html`<div style="width:${facetW}px;text-align:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:bold;color:#333;">${d}</div>`)}
  </div>`;

  // Grid rows — excludes Trend (shown separately below as full-record map)
  const gridRows = gridStats.map(stat => {
    const extent = statExtent.get(stat);
    const cells = decades.map(dec => {
      const crossingMap = byStatDecade.get(stat)?.get(dec) ?? new Map();
      const svg = d3.create("svg")
        .attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${facetW} ${facetH}`)
        .attr("width", facetW).attr("height", facetH)
        .style("border", "1px solid #eee");
      const g = svg.append("g").attr("transform", "translate(4,4)");
      // Background boundaries
      for (const f of features) {
        g.append("path").attr("d", path0(f))
          .attr("fill", "#f5f5f5").attr("stroke", "#888").attr("stroke-width", 0.4);
      }
      // Coloured fill
      for (const f of features) {
        const v = crossingMap.get(f.properties[featProp]) ?? null;
        if (v == null) continue;
        g.append("path").attr("d", path0(f))
          .attr("fill", colourFn(stat, v, extent)).attr("stroke", "none");
        g.select("path:last-child").append("title")
          .text(`${f.properties[featProp]}: ${v?.toFixed(2)} ${unit[stat]}`);
      }
      // Boundary lines on top
      for (const f of features) {
        g.append("path").attr("d", path0(f))
          .attr("fill", "none").attr("stroke", "#888").attr("stroke-width", 0.4);
      }
      return svg.node();
    });

    // Gradient legend for this stat
    const [lo, hi] = extent;
    const isSymm = SYMM_STATS.has(stat);
    const nStops = 10;
    const stops = d3.range(nStops).map(i => colourFn(stat, lo + i / (nStops-1) * (hi - lo), extent)).join(",");
    const legW = facetW * decades.length + (decades.length - 1) * 4;
    const dirLoGrid = stat === "Mean anomaly"
      ? (isWetVar ? "← drier" : "← cooler")
      : stat === "Variability (σ)" ? "← stable" : null;
    const dirHiGrid = stat === "Mean anomaly"
      ? (isWetVar ? "wetter →" : "warmer →")
      : stat === "Variability (σ)" ? "volatile →" : null;
    const varNote = stat === "Variability (σ)" ? "· inter-annual std. dev." : null;
    const legEl = htl.html`<div style="margin:2px 0 4px ${labelW}px;font-size:9px;color:#666;">
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
        ${dirLoGrid ? htl.html`<span style="font-style:italic;color:#999;white-space:nowrap;">${dirLoGrid}</span>` : ""}
        <span>${lo.toFixed(1)}</span>
        <span style="display:inline-block;width:100px;height:8px;background:linear-gradient(to right,${stops});border-radius:2px;border:1px solid #ddd;flex-shrink:0;"></span>
        <span>${hi.toFixed(1)} ${unit[stat]}</span>
        ${dirHiGrid ? htl.html`<span style="font-style:italic;color:#999;white-space:nowrap;">${dirHiGrid}</span>` : ""}
        ${varNote ? htl.html`<span style="color:#aaa;">${varNote}</span>` : ""}
      </div>
    </div>`;

    return htl.html`<div style="margin-bottom:8px;">
      <div style="display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:flex-start;">
        <div style="width:${labelW}px;font-size:10px;font-weight:bold;color:#555;padding-top:4px;text-align:right;padding-right:8px;">${stat}</div>
        ${cells}
      </div>
      ${legEl}
    </div>`;
  });

  // Full-record trend maps (shown when Trend is selected).
  // Method: Theil-Sen slope + Mann-Kendall + TFPW — same as main notebook.
  let trendMap = "";
  if (stats.includes("Trend (per decade)")) {
    const byKey  = d3.group(p6_obs_raw, d => d.join_key);
    const yMin   = d3.min(p6_obs_raw, d => d.year);
    const yMax2  = d3.max(p6_obs_raw, d => d.year);
    const baseMeans = p6_base_means;

    // Per-admin1: Theil-Sen mean trend + variability trend.
    // Variability: slope of |anomaly| normalised by baseline σ → % change/decade.
    // SPEI is already a z-score — skip variability trend for it.
    const showVarTrend = !isSPEI;
    const mkResults = new Map([...byKey].map(([k, rows]) => {
      const sorted = rows.sort((a,b) => a.year - b.year);
      const vals  = sorted.map(d => d.value_mean);
      const years = sorted.map(d => d.year);
      const mk    = mannKendall(vals, { xValues: years, minN: 15 });
      if (!showVarTrend) return [k, { mk, mkVar: null, mkVarPct: null }];
      const [blo, bhi] = p6_controls.baseline === "1991-2020" ? [1991,2020] : [1995,2014];
      const baseRows = sorted.filter(d => d.year >= blo && d.year <= bhi);
      const bMean  = d3.mean(baseRows, d => d.value_mean) ?? 0;
      const bSigma = d3.deviation(baseRows, d => d.value_mean) || 1;
      // For PTOT in near-zero areas (mean < 10mm), variability % is meaningless.
      // Skip these to avoid desert inflation artefact.
      if (isPTOT && Math.abs(bMean) < 10) return [k, { mk, mkVar: null, mkVarPct: null }];
      // Detrended residuals: subtract Theil-Sen fitted line to remove mean-shift confound.
      const slope = mk.slope || 0;
      const xm    = d3.mean(years);
      const ym    = d3.mean(vals);
      const intercept = ym - slope * xm;
      const residuals = sorted.map(d => ({
        year: d.year,
        resid: Math.abs(d.value_mean - (slope * d.year + intercept)),
      }));
      // Rolling 5-year σ of residuals — tracks genuine variability change.
      const rollingPts = residuals.slice(2, -2).map((_, i) => {
        const win = residuals.slice(i, i + 5).map(r => r.resid);
        return { year: residuals[i + 2].year, value: d3.mean(win) };
      }).filter(d => d.value != null);
      const mkVar = mannKendall(rollingPts.map(d => d.value), { xValues: rollingPts.map(d => d.year), minN: 10 });
      const mkVarPct = mkVar.slopePerDecade != null ? mkVar.slopePerDecade / bSigma * 100 : null;
      return [k, { mk, mkVar, mkVarPct }];
    }));

    const renderTrendMap = (title, note, valueOf, sigOf, overrideUnit, isVarMap = false) => {
      const tUnit = overrideUnit ?? unit["Trend (per decade)"];
      // Colour direction: variability=volatile→red; temp=warming→red; precip/SPEI=wetting→blue.
      const trendDir = t => isVarMap ? 1 - t : (isWetVar ? t : 1 - t);
      const trendColour = (v, ext) => {
        if (v == null) return "#ddd";
        const [lo, hi] = ext;
        const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (v - lo) / (hi - lo)));
        return cbMode ? d3.interpolatePuOr(trendDir(t)) : d3.interpolateRdBu(trendDir(t));
      };
      // Direction labels depend on map type, not unit string.
      const dirLo = isVarMap ? "← stable"    : isWetVar ? "← drying"  : "← cooling";
      const dirHi = isVarMap ? "volatile →"  : isWetVar ? "wetting →" : "warming →";
      const tVals = [...mkResults.values()].map(valueOf).filter(v => v != null);
      if (!tVals.length) return null;
      const tMax = d3.max(tVals, Math.abs) || 1;
      const tExt = [-tMax, tMax];
      const tMapW = Math.min(width - labelW, 340);
      const tMapH = Math.round(tMapW * 1.1);
      const tProj = d3.geoMercator().fitSize([tMapW - 8, tMapH - 8], { type:"FeatureCollection", features });
      const tPath = d3.geoPath().projection(tProj);
      const svg = d3.create("svg").attr("viewBox",`0 0 ${tMapW} ${tMapH}`)
        .attr("width", tMapW).attr("height", tMapH).style("border","1px solid #eee");
      const g = svg.append("g").attr("transform","translate(4,4)");
      // Background
      for (const f of features) g.append("path").attr("d",tPath(f))
        .attr("fill","#f5f5f5").attr("stroke","none");

      const nFeat   = features.length;
      const useFade = nFeat > 80;          // always fade for regional views
      const showBdr = p6_controls.sigBorders;
      const showDot = p6_controls.sigDots && !useFade;  // dots only for country view
      const sigBdrW = nFeat <= 50 ? 1.0 : 0.6;

      // Coloured fill — fade non-significant for regional views.
      for (const f of features) {
        const res = mkResults.get(f.properties[featProp]);
        const v = res ? valueOf(res) : null;
        if (v == null) continue;
        const sig = res && sigOf(res);
        g.append("path").attr("d",tPath(f))
          .attr("fill", trendColour(v, tExt))
          .attr("fill-opacity", useFade ? (sig ? 1.0 : 0.22) : 1.0)
          .attr("stroke","none");
      }

      // Boundary lines — all features.
      for (const f of features) g.append("path").attr("d",tPath(f))
        .attr("fill","none").attr("stroke","#888").attr("stroke-width",0.3);

      // Significance markers on top — controlled by toggles.
      if (showBdr) for (const f of features) {
        const res = mkResults.get(f.properties[featProp]);
        if (!res || !sigOf(res)) continue;
        g.append("path").attr("d",tPath(f))
          .attr("fill","none").attr("stroke","#111").attr("stroke-width",sigBdrW);
        if (showDot) {
          const [cx, cy] = tProj(d3.geoCentroid(f)) ?? [0,0];
          g.append("circle").attr("cx",cx).attr("cy",cy).attr("r",2)
            .attr("fill","white").attr("fill-opacity",0.85);
        }
      }
      const tStops = d3.range(10).map(i => trendColour(-tMax + i/9*2*tMax, tExt)).join(",");
      return htl.html`<div style="flex:0 0 auto;max-width:${tMapW + 8}px;">
        <div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:bold;color:#555;margin-bottom:3px;">${title}</div>
        <div style="font-size:9px;color:#888;margin-bottom:3px;max-width:${tMapW}px;white-space:normal;">${note}</div>
        ${svg.node()}
        <div style="font-size:9px;color:#666;margin-top:2px;">
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
            <span style="font-style:italic;">${dirLo}</span>
            <span>${(-tMax).toFixed(2)}</span>
            <span style="display:inline-block;width:70px;height:7px;background:linear-gradient(to right,${tStops});border-radius:2px;border:1px solid #ddd;"></span>
            <span>+${tMax.toFixed(2)} ${tUnit}</span>
            <span style="font-style:italic;">${dirHi}</span>
          </div>
          <div style="margin-top:2px;color:#444;">
            Significance (p &lt; 0.05):
            ${showBdr ? "black border" : ""}${showBdr && showDot ? " + " : ""}${showDot ? "● dot" : ""}
            ${!showBdr && !showDot ? "significance indicators off" : ""}
            ${useFade ? " · faded = not significant (regional)" : ""}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    };

    const meanTrendEl = renderTrendMap(
      `Mean trend — ${yMin}–${yMax2}`,
      "Theil-Sen slope + Mann-Kendall + TFPW · same method as main notebook",
      r => r.mk?.slopePerDecade ?? null,
      r => r.mk?.significant5pct ?? false,
      unit["Trend (per decade)"]
    );
    const varTrendEl = showVarTrend ? renderTrendMap(
      `Variability trend — ${yMin}–${yMax2}`,
      "% change/decade in detrended residual variability (Theil-Sen of rolling 5-yr mean-absolute-residual, normalised by baseline σ). Detrended = mean shift removed.",
      r => r.mkVarPct ?? null,
      r => r.mkVar?.significant5pct ?? false,
      "%/decade"
    ) : null;

    trendMap = meanTrendEl || varTrendEl ? htl.html`<div style="margin-top:14px;border-top:1px solid #ddd;padding-top:8px;">
      <div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:bold;color:#444;margin-bottom:6px;">Full-record trend maps</div>
      <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;">
        ${meanTrendEl ?? ""}${varTrendEl ?? ""}
      </div>
    </div>` : "";
  }

  return htl.html`<div>
    <p style="font-size:0.83em;color:#777;margin:2px 0 6px;">
      ${scope} · ${variable} · ${season} · baseline ${p6_controls.baseline}
    </p>
    ${colH}${gridRows}${trendMap}
    <p style="font-size:0.78em;color:#888;font-style:italic;margin:8px 0 0;line-height:1.4;max-width:980px;">
      <strong>Reading note:</strong> The decade-grid trend (when selected) is a simple OLS slope on
      ≤10-year windows — indicative only, low statistical power. The full-record trend maps below
      use Theil-Sen + Mann-Kendall with TFPW (trend-free pre-whitening; Yue &amp; Wang 2002) — the
      same method used in the main notebook. Significance: black border / dot marks p &lt; 0.05;
      for regional views with &gt;80 features, non-significant admin1s are faded instead.
    </p>
  </div>`;
}
```

---

## Notes

- **P1 (Year overlay):** Temperature only — PTOT seasonal amplitude swamps year-to-year signal.
- **P3 (Ridge plot):** Always uses anomaly regardless of the P1 toggle. PTOT ridge is noisier but
  can still show shift in wet/dry season distributions.
- **P2 (Spiral):** Radius = anomaly. Incomplete rings (2026 Jan–Apr) render as open arcs.
- **P4 (Polar heatmap):** All variables; anomaly or absolute toggle. Inner = oldest year, outer = most recent.
- **CB toggle** applies to P1, P2, P3, P4.
- **CR-097:** Choropleth colour = first 20-year period crossing the threshold. Table below shows per-admin1 detail. If features don't filter correctly the topojson property name for country filtering may need adjustment.

---

## References

Climate data products:

- **Funk, C., Peterson, P., Landsfeld, M. et al.** (2015). The Climate Hazards Infrared Precipitation with Stations — a new environmental record for monitoring extremes. *Scientific Data* **2**, 150066. <https://doi.org/10.1038/sdata.2015.66> *(CHIRPS — precipitation)*
- **Funk, C., Peterson, P., Peterson, S. et al.** (2019). A High-Resolution 1983–2016 Tmax Climate Data Record Based on Infrared Temperatures and Stations by the Climate Hazard Center. *Journal of Climate* **32**, 5639–5658. <https://doi.org/10.1175/JCLI-D-18-0698.1> *(CHIRTS — temperature)*
- **Hersbach, H., Bell, B., Berrisford, P. et al.** (2020). The ERA5 global reanalysis. *Quarterly Journal of the Royal Meteorological Society* **146**, 1999–2049. <https://doi.org/10.1002/qj.3803> *(ERA5 reanalysis used in CHIRTS-ERA5 hybrid)*
- **Thrasher, B., Wang, W., Michaelis, A., Melton, F., Lee, T. & Nemani, R.** (2022). NASA Global Daily Downscaled Projections, CMIP6. *Earth and Space Science* **9**, e2022EA002329. <https://doi.org/10.1029/2022EA002329> *(NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 — used by CR-097)*

Statistical methods:

- **Silverman, B. W.** (1986). *Density Estimation for Statistics and Data Analysis*. Chapman and Hall, London. *(KDE bandwidth rule used in P3)*
- **Mann, H. B.** (1945). Nonparametric tests against trend. *Econometrica* **13**, 245–259. *(Mann-Kendall trend test, used in P6)*
- **Kendall, M. G.** (1975). *Rank Correlation Methods*, 4th ed. Griffin, London. *(Companion to Mann 1945)*
- **Yue, S. & Wang, C. Y.** (2002). Applicability of pre-whitening to eliminate the influence of serial correlation on the Mann-Kendall test. *Water Resources Research* **38**(6). <https://doi.org/10.1029/2001WR000861> *(TFPW pre-whitening, used in P6 full-record trend maps)*
- **Vicente-Serrano, S. M., Beguería, S. & López-Moreno, J. I.** (2010). A multiscalar drought index sensitive to global warming: the Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index. *Journal of Climate* **23**, 1696–1718. <https://doi.org/10.1175/2009JCLI2909.1> *(SPEI definition, used as a P6 variable)*

Framing / concept references:

- **Hawkins, E., Sutton, R. & Stainforth, D.** (2017). Connecting climate model projections of global temperature change with the real world. *Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society* **98**, 999–1004. <https://doi.org/10.1175/BAMS-D-16-0181.1> *(Climate-spiral concept — P2)*
- **IPCC, 2021: Climate Change 2021: The Physical Science Basis.** Contribution of Working Group I to the Sixth Assessment Report. Cambridge University Press. Chapter 4 (Lee, J.-Y. et al.) — *Future Global Climate: Scenario-Based Projections and Near-Term Information* — for the constrained-projections framing used to interpret CR-097's ensemble-mean threshold-crossing limitation.
